messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Re: RStan Failed to Install: Use of this header (template_arity_spec.hpp) is deprecated
parts:
Boost is the library we're using for a lot of C++ wrangling,
and BH (cran) is how we get it in R. BH upgraded their version
of Boost beyond where Stan was at and what you're seeing is warnings
that a function in Boost is going to go away in the future. We've
already tested that everything's OK, but are still working on
getting rid of the deprecation warnings. Should be taken care
of soon.

- Bob
